SELECT r.* FROM app.cards r WHERE r.user_id=$1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.decks d WHERE d.id=r.deck_id AND d.user_id=$1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) AND ((CASE WHEN getdatabaseencoding()='UTF8'
    AND lower('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
    AND octet_length(r.word)=length(r.word)
    THEN r.word COLLATE "C" ILIKE lower($2::text COLLATE "default") COLLATE "C"
    ELSE r.word ILIKE $2::text END) OR (CASE WHEN getdatabaseencoding()='UTF8'
    AND lower('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
    AND octet_length(r.meaning)=length(r.meaning)
    THEN r.meaning COLLATE "C" ILIKE lower($2::text COLLATE "default") COLLATE "C"
    ELSE r.meaning ILIKE $2::text END)) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id ASC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

queries.sql: SELECT r.* FROM app.cards r WHERE r.user_id=$1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.decks d WHERE d.id=r.deck_id AND d.user_id=$1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id ASC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

SELECT id,card_id,quality,score,reviewed_at,received_at,timezone_at_review,algorithm_version
        FROM app.review_events WHERE user_id=$1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR card_id=$2::uuid)
        ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

SELECT id,card_id,quality,score,reviewed_at,received_at,timezone_at_review,algorithm_version
        FROM app.review_events WHERE user_id=$1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR card_id=$2::uuid)
        ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
SELECT timezone FROM app.profiles WHERE user_id=$1

SELECT count(*)::int AS total_cards,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.card_id IS NULL)::int AS new_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.repetitions=0)::int AS relearning_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.repetitions BETWEEN 1 AND 2)::int AS learning_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.repetitions>=3)::int AS mastered_count,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.due_at < (($2::date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $3))::int AS due_today_count
        FROM app.cards c JOIN app.decks d ON d.user_id=c.user_id AND d.id=c.deck_id
        LEFT JOIN app.review_states s ON s.user_id=c.user_id AND s.card_id=c.id
        WHERE c.user_id=$1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT to_char(reviewed_at AT TIME ZONE $2,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day,
        count(*)::int AS reviews,count(*) FILTER(WHERE quality>=3)::int AS successful_reviews
        FROM app.review_events WHERE user_id=$1 AND reviewed_at <= $3::timestamptz
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
SELECT last_sequence FROM app.sync_heads WHERE user_id=$1
SELECT sequence::text,entity_type,entity_id,snapshot AS record FROM app.sync_changes WHERE user_id=$1 AND sequence>$2::bigint AND sequence<=$3::bigint ORDER BY app.sync_changes.sequence LIMIT $4
SELECT last_sequence FROM app.review_heads WHERE user_id=$1

SELECT sequence::text,user_id,id,card_id,quality,score,reviewed_at,received_at,timezone_at_review,algorithm_version
        FROM app.review_events WHERE user_id=$1 AND sequence>$2::bigint AND sequence<=$3::bigint
        ORDER BY app.review_events.sequence LIMIT $4
